environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with the following configuration: (1) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with action override set to BLOCK and sensitivity level HIGH applied to all requests matching the scope-down statement for URI path '/api/*'; (2) A custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP; (3) The ECS task role IAM policy has a permission boundary that denies s3:*, dynamodb:*, and secretsmanager:* preventing any lateral movement even if code execution is achieved via stacked queries. The task runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS access point with uid/gid enforcement.
